periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of the eye patches are oriented vertically with a slight inward tilt towards the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval shape with a significantly higher vertical-to-horizontal ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: There is a visible downward tapering effect where the lower portion of the patch extends further from the center than the upper portion.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band is thick and continuous across the shoulders, occupying approximately one-third of the visible upper torso height at the lateral flanks.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are widely set, separated by a distance approximately equal to the width of the cranial apex.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The top boundaries of the ears exhibit a smooth, convex semicircular curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant brownish-yellow discolouration of the fur in the pelvic and lower abdominal region; mouth is open exposing lower dentition.
